Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2400–2409)

- Past behavior: selected C (regional office) for every request. Most were rejected: “option C is not valid for this request.”
- C accepted only:
  - REQ-2404: large shipment, south region.
  - REQ-2407: large invoice, north region.
- C rejected for:
  - small claim east/north; small invoice north; small refund north.
  - large shipment east; large invoice east; large refund south; large claim south.
- Tentative rule: C is valid only for large requests where type + region match: shipment + south or invoice + north. Size may matter: north invoice small was rejected.
- Sender/role and message phrasing (“same as last month,” “scanned,” “second attempt,” “client asking twice,” etc.) did not predict acceptance.
- Do not default to C. If the request is not a large shipment/south or large invoice/north, C will likely be rejected.
- A (standard queue) and B (priority desk) outcomes are untested. No evidence yet to prefer A vs B when C is invalid; follow current desk-selection policy or try one and record outcome.
- Recheck if more accepted C cases emerge; update rule.

Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2400–2419)

- Sender/role and phrasing do not predict acceptance. Use request type/size/region.
- Confirmed accepted:
  - A: small claim/east (REQ-2411); small invoice/north (REQ-2415).
  - C: large shipment/south (REQ-2404, 2418); large invoice/north (REQ-2407).
- Confirmed rejected:
  - B: large claim/east (2410, 2412); large shipment/north (2419). No B acceptances yet.
  - A: large shipment/east (2413); small refund/north (2414); small shipment/north (2417).
  - C: small claim east/north; small invoice north; small refund north; large shipment east; large invoice east; large refund south; large claim south.
  - D: not valid.
- Do not default to C. C only confirmed for large shipment/south and large invoice/north.
- A is confirmed for small claim/east and small invoice/north; A has otherwise failed for several tested small/large cases.
- B is untested for most remaining combos; all B attempts so far rejected.
- For an untested combo, follow current desk-selection policy. If none, prefer A unless A already rejected; then try B, or C if combo matches prior C rule. Record outcome.
- Recheck and update when more accepted cases emerge.

- Confirmed rejected:

  - B: large claim/east (2410, 2412); large shipment/north (2419); small shipment/north (2426).
  - C: small claim east/north; small invoice north; small refund north; large shipment east; large invoice east; large refund south; large claim south.
  - D invalid.
- Do not default to A or C. A is only confirmed for the three small rules above; it often fails for nearby small/large combos. C only confirmed for large shipment/south and large invoice/north. B only confirmed for small refund/north.
- For an untested combo: use the matching accepted rule if available. If none, do not blindly try A; if A is already rejected for that combo, test B or C and record outcome.
- Notable gaps: small claim/north has A and C rejected → try B. Large claim/east has A and B rejected → try C. Large shipment/north and small shipment/north have A and B rejected → try C.
- Recheck and update when more accepted cases emerge.
